consumer: The engine's mission/job completion check (e.g. mission::is_complete) asking 'is the courier job in its completable, ready-to-hand-in state?'
scope: The full courier-mission completion predicate the engine evaluates (required item identity/quantity plus any place/proximity/NPC conditions), not the avatar's carried-item inventory
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_carried_items, which dumps wielded/worn/inventory items as raw avatar state (S) rather than evaluating the mission's completion predicate
divergence: A courier mission whose required delivery item the player has already stowed in a nearby vehicle/dropped (or holds a wrong variant), or which also requires proximity to the target NPC: carried_items would report 'have it / don't have it' disagreeing with the mission's actual is_complete result
